name: Superbia
description: A yellowish, rather viscous injection. It is extremely unpleasant to inject at first, but gives a massive power high shortly after.
detriment: Psi powers’ costs are increased by 1.
overdose_effect: The user suffers Fear whenever something vaguely threatening happens, for a week. After that one Fear or Phobia Bane is increased by 2.

name: Arc
description: A red vial, almost the color of blood. It provides enough energy to severely limit the toll the body takes from casting psychic powers.
effect: The effect takes 5 minutes to set in. The next psionic power cast after that has its cost limited to 3.
detriment: If no power is cast during the time, the user suffers \emph{Shock}.
overdose_effect: The user's Cassandra implant turns off for D5 days and the user suffers D10 damage (ignoring armor and toughness).

name: Helium Stabilizer
description: A light blue capsule. Tastes and smells fresh, like mint.
detriment: Psionics tests suffer a -10 penalty. The user’s voice pitch rises.
overdose_effect: The user becomes extremely sleepy. He suffers -20 to almost everything from lack of focus, and will fall asleep when he sits down.
